body: My task list is ordered by date. When I create a new task I have to set the date otherwise it goes to the bottom of the list. I don’t like that, it is easy to be ignored. body:
Automatically adds tasks based on emails which is good however the item added lands on the default list which might not be the right place for our. I cannot move items between the lists and on pc having issues of a task was accidentally ticked off.

Nevertheless the idea is nice, integration is welcome but still needs a lot of UCD improvements.
